name: next-episode-countdown
intent: A next-up card counts down visibly from 5 to 0 then hands off to the next episode automatically; CANCEL stops it and restores the end-state.

states.counting: END OF EPISODE scene, next-up card visible, ring filling
states.playing: automatic hand-off at count 0, next-up dismissed
states.cancelled: CANCEL stops the countdown, next-up dismissed, scene stays END OF EPISODE

triggers.replay: REPLAY button restarts the whole sequence

a11y.liveStatus: polite text reporting remaining seconds and final outcome

reducedMotion.behaviour: Same countdown/hand-off/cancel states occur with the dismiss transition removed
